en.s: The Battle of the Cremera was fought between the Roman Republic and the Etruscan city of Veii, in 477 BC (AUC 277). It most likely occurred on 18 July, although Ovid gives a different date of 13 February.
en.n: Battle of the Cremera as part of the Roman–Etruscan Wars. Veii ambushes and defeats the Roman army.

zh.s: 克雷梅拉战役发生于公元前477年（罗马建城纪年277年），交战双方是罗马共和国和伊特鲁里亚城市维爱。战役日期很可能是7月18日，但奥维德记载的日期是2月13日。
zh.n: 克雷梅拉战役是罗马—伊特鲁里亚战争的一部分。维爱军伏击并击败了罗马军队。

en.s: The Great Fire of Rome (Latin: incendium magnum Romae) began on the evening of 18–19 July 64 AD. The fire started in the merchant shops around Rome's chariot stadium, Circus Maximus. After six days, the fire was brought under control, but before the damage could be assessed, the fire reignited and burned for another three days.
en.n: The Great Fire of Rome (Latin: incendium magnum Romae) began on the evening of 18–19 July 64 AD.

zh.s: 罗马大火（拉丁语：incendium magnum Romae）于公元64年7月18日至19日夜间开始。大火起于罗马战车竞技场马克西穆斯竞技场周边的商铺。火势持续6天后得到控制，但损失尚未评估，大火便再次燃起，又持续了3天。
zh.n: 罗马大火（拉丁语：incendium magnum Romae）于公元64年7月18日至19日夜间开始。

en.s: Battle of Alarcos (July 18, 1195), was a battle between the Almohads led by Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur and King Alfonso VIII of Castile. It resulted in the defeat of the Castilian forces and their subsequent retreat to Toledo whereas the Almohads conquered back Trujillo, Montánchez and Talavera.

zh.s: 阿拉科斯战役于1195年7月18日爆发，交战双方是阿尔摩哈德王朝军队和卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世的军队。阿尔摩哈德军由阿布·优素福·雅各布·曼苏尔率领。卡斯蒂利亚军战败，随后撤退至托莱多。阿尔摩哈德军则夺回特鲁希略、蒙坦切斯和塔拉韦拉。

en.s: The Battle of Zava was fought on July 18, 1342 between the armies of the Sarbadars and the Kartids (or Kurt dynasty). Since their appearance as a political force in Khorasan, the Sarbadars had fought to expand their influence in north-eastern Iran and defend against the forces of the claiming Ilkhan Togha Temür who sought to regain Khorasan. Mu'izz al-Din Husain, the chief of the Kartids of Herat recognized Togha Temur's overlordship, and when the Sarbadars secured their hold on Khorasan they sought to eliminate the Kartid threat to the east.

zh.s: 扎瓦战役于1342年7月18日爆发，交战双方是萨尔巴达尔王朝和卡尔特王朝（又称库尔特王朝）的军队。萨尔巴达尔人作为呼罗珊地区的一股政治力量出现后，便努力扩大其在伊朗东北部的影响力，并抵御自称伊尔汗的脱黑鲁帖木儿所率部队；后者试图重新夺回呼罗珊。赫拉特卡尔特王朝首领穆伊兹丁·侯赛因承认脱黑鲁帖木儿的宗主权。萨尔巴达尔人巩固了对呼罗珊的控制后，试图消除东方卡尔特王朝带来的威胁。

en.s: The Truce of Leulinghem was a truce agreed to by Richard II's kingdom of England and its allies, and Charles VI's kingdom of France and its allies, on 18 July 1389, ending the Caroline War of the Hundred Years' War. England was on the edge of financial collapse and suffering from internal political divisions.

en.s: Charles V (24 February 1500 – 21 September 1558) was Holy Roman Emperor and Archduke of Austria from 1519 to 1556, King of Spain (as Charles I) from 1516 to 1556, King of Sicily and Naples from 1516 to 1554, and also Lord of the Netherlands and titular Duke of Burgundy (as Charles II) from 1506 to 1555. He was heir to and then head of the rising House of Habsburg.

zh.t: 布鲁塞尔的查理王子在继承头衔一年后加冕为勃艮第公爵和佛兰德伯爵
zh.s: 查理五世（1500年2月24日—1558年9月21日）于1519年至1556年担任神圣罗马皇帝和奥地利大公，1516年至1556年以查理一世之名担任西班牙国王，1516年至1554年担任西西里和那不勒斯国王，并于1506年至1555年以查理二世之名担任尼德兰领主和名义上的勃艮第公爵。他是势力日益壮大的哈布斯堡王朝继承人，后来成为该王朝首领。

en.s: The Second Desmond Rebellion (1579–1583) was the more widespread and bloody of the two Desmond Rebellions in Ireland launched by the FitzGerald Dynasty of Desmond in Munster against English rule. The second rebellion began in July 1579 when James FitzMaurice FitzGerald landed in Ireland with a force of Papal troops, triggering an insurrection across the south of Ireland on the part of the Desmond dynasty, their allies, and others who were dissatisfied for various reasons with English government of the country.

zh.s: 第二次德斯蒙德叛乱（1579—1583年）是德斯蒙德菲茨杰拉德王朝在芒斯特针对英国统治发起的两次叛乱中，规模更大、伤亡更惨重的一次。1579年7月，詹姆斯·菲茨莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德率领教皇国军队登陆爱尔兰，叛乱由此爆发。德斯蒙德王朝及其盟友和其他因各种原因不满英国统治的人，随后在爱尔兰南部发动起义。

en.t: Watts' West Indies and Virginia expedition
en.s: Watts' West Indies and Virginia expedition also known as the Action of Cape Tiburon was an English expedition to the Spanish Main during the Anglo–Spanish War. The expedition began on 10 May and ended by 18 July 1590 and was commanded by Abraham Cocke and Christopher Newport. This was financed by the highly renowned London merchant John Watts.

en.s: The battle of Ladyzhyn or battle of Ładyżyn (Polish: Bitwa pod Ładyżynem) took place on July 18, 1672, during the Polish–Ottoman War (1672–76). It involved a 30,000 strong army, which consisted of Crimean Tatars and a unit of Zaporozhian Cossacks loyal to Petro Doroshenko, and a pro-Polish regiment of Cossack Hetman Mykhailo Khanenko. The forces met near Ladyzhyn, which at that time was called Ładyżyn. Since Khanenko’s regiment numbered only 4,000 soldiers, he asked for help from the Castellan of Podlasie, Karol Luzecki, with 2,500 cavalry and dragoons. Khanenko and Luzecki joined forces on July 18, and marched towards the village of Czetwertynowka.

zh.s: 拉迪任战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Ładyżynem）于1672年7月18日爆发，属于1672—1676年波兰—奥斯曼战争的一部分。参战的一支3万人大军由克里米亚鞑靼人和一支效忠佩特罗·多罗申科的扎波罗热哥萨克部队组成，对阵亲波兰的哥萨克盖特曼米哈伊洛·哈年科部队。哈年科麾下只有4000人，于是向波德拉谢城主卡罗尔·卢泽茨基请求援助。卢泽茨基率2500名骑兵和龙骑兵前来，两人于7月18日会师并向切特韦尔蒂诺夫卡村进军。

en.s: The Battle of Elixheim, 18 July 1705, also known as the Passage of the Lines of Brabant was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. The Duke of Marlborough successfully broke through the French Lines of Brabant, an arc of defensive fieldworks stretching in a seventy-mile arc from Antwerp to Namur. Although he was unable to bring about a decisive battle, the breaking and subsequent razing of the lines would prove critical to the allied victory at Ramillies the next year.

zh.s: 埃利克斯海姆战役又称布拉班特防线突破战，于1705年7月18日在西班牙王位继承战争期间爆发。马尔伯勒公爵成功突破法国的布拉班特防线。这道防线由野战工事构成，从安特卫普至那慕尔延伸约70英里。马尔伯勒未能迫使法军进行决定性会战，但突破并随后摧毁防线，对盟军翌年在拉米伊战役获胜起到了关键作用。

en.t: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz, BWV 136, in Leipzig on the eighth Sunday after Trinity
en.s: Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz (Search me, God, and know my heart), BWV 136 is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. Bach composed the cantata in 1723 in Leipzig to be used for the eighth Sunday after Trinity. He led the first performance on 18 July 1723.

zh.t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫首次指挥演出康塔塔《求你鉴察我，认识我的心》（BWV 136）
zh.s: 《求你鉴察我，认识我的心》（Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz，BWV 136）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的一首教会康塔塔。巴赫于1723年在莱比锡创作这部作品，供圣灵降临节后第八个主日使用，并于1723年7月18日首次指挥演出。

en.s: The siege of Philippsburg was conducted by French forces against troops of the Holy Roman Empire in the fortress of Philippsburg in the Rhine River valley during the War of the Polish Succession. The Duke of Berwick led 100,000 men up the Rhine Valley, of which 60,000 were detached to invest the fortress at Philippsburg, beginning on 26 May 1734.

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Marsh took place on July 18, 1742 (new style) between Spanish and British forces on St. Simons Island, part of the Province of Georgia, resulting in a victory for the British. Part of the War of Jenkins' Ear, the battle was for the British fortifications of Fort Frederica and Fort St. Simons, with the strategic goal the sea routes and inland waters they controlled.

zh.s: 格利霍尔溪战役于1742年7月18日（新历）爆发，交战双方为佐治亚省的西班牙军队和英国军队，最终英军获胜。该战役属于更大规模的“詹金斯耳朵战争”，双方争夺圣西蒙斯岛以及英国在岛上的弗雷德里卡堡和圣……堡防御工事。

zh.s: 卡斯泰尔德尔菲诺第二次战役是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场军事交战，于1744年7月发生在法国与撒丁王国之间。

en.s: The Battle of Dubienka occurred during the Polish–Russian War of 1792 (War of the Second Partition of Poland) where on July 18, 1792, the Polish army under the command of General Tadeusz Kościuszko defended the Bug River crossing against the Russian army under General Michail Kachovski. Although the Russians had a numerical advantage of 5:1 over the Polish defenders, their attacks were stymied by field fortifications raised by the Poles, leading to a Polish tactical victory. Subsequent Russian flanking forced the Poles to retreat to avoid being encircled. After the Polish-Lithuanian forces left their forward positions, the Russian army occupied the area.

zh.s: 杜比恩卡战役发生于1792年波兰—俄罗斯战争（又称第二次瓜分波兰战争）期间。1792年7月18日，塔德乌什·柯斯丘什科将军率领波兰军队，在布格河渡口抵御米哈伊尔·卡霍夫斯基将军指挥的俄军。俄军人数是波兰守军的5倍，但波军修筑的野战工事挡住了进攻，使波兰人在战术上获胜。俄军随后从侧翼包抄，迫使波军撤退以免被包围。波兰—立陶宛联军撤离前沿阵地后，俄军占领了该地区。

en.s: The Battle of Vihiers (18 July 1793) was a battle between Royalist and Republican French forces at Vihiers during the War in the Vendée. After the Republican division under Jacques-Marie Pilote La Barolière advanced into the heart of the revolt area, it was attacked by the Vendeans under Dominique Piron de La Vienne and routed. The advance guard under Jacques-François Menou held its ground for a long time, but many Republican units from the main body quickly took to their heels. The Republican cavalry under Louis-Nicolas Davout covered the disorderly retreat.

zh.s: 维耶尔战役于1793年7月18日在旺代战争期间爆发，交战双方是保王派与法国共和派军队。雅克-马里·皮洛特·拉巴罗利埃率领共和军一个师深入叛乱地区后，遭多米尼克·皮龙·德·拉维埃纳率领的旺代军袭击并被击溃。雅克-弗朗索瓦·梅努率领的先头部队坚守了很长时间，但主力中许多共和军部队很快溃逃。路易-尼古拉·达武率领的共和军骑兵掩护了这场混乱的撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Blanc-Nez and Gris-Nez was fought on 18 July 1805 between a combined flotilla of the Batavian Navy and French Imperial Navy under Carel Hendrik Ver Huell and a Royal Navy fleet under Admiral of the Blue Lord Keith during the War of the Third Coalition. Ver Huell's flotilla was able to resist several attacks from the British and successfully reached Boulogne-sur-Mer.

zh.t: 布朗内角与格里内角海战
zh.s: 布朗内角与格里内角海战于1805年7月18日爆发，是第三次反法同盟战争的一部分。巴达维亚海军与法国帝国海军组成的联合舰队由卡雷尔·亨德里克·费尔·胡尔指挥，英国皇家海军舰队则由海军中将基思勋爵率领。费尔·胡尔的舰队顶住英军多次进攻，成功抵达滨海布洛涅。

en.s: On 18 July 1806, approximately 40,000 lb (18,000 kg) of gunpowder stored in a magazine (polverista) in Birgu, Malta, mistakenly detonated. The explosion killed an estimated 200 people, including British and Maltese military personnel, and Maltese civilians from Birgu. Parts of the city's fortifications, some naval stores, and many houses were destroyed. The accident was found to be the result of negligence while transferring shells from the magazine.

zh.s: 1806年7月18日，储存在马耳他比尔古一处火药库（polverista）中的约40000磅（18000公斤）火药意外爆炸。事故估计造成200人死亡，其中包括英国和马耳他军人，以及来自比尔古的马耳他平民。城防工事的部分设施、一些海军物资和许多房屋被毁。调查认定，事故是转移炮弹时疏忽所致。

en.s: The siege of Gaeta (26 February – 18 July 1806) saw the fortress city of Gaeta and its Neapolitan garrison under General Louis of Hesse-Philippsthal besieged by an Imperial French corps led by Marshal André Masséna. After a prolonged defense in which Hesse was severely wounded, Gaeta surrendered, and Masséna granted its garrison generous terms.

en.s: The invasion of Naples was a military campaign of the War of the Third Coalition in 1806. It began when a French army led by Marshal André Masséna marched from Northern Italy into the Kingdom of Naples, an ally of the Coalition against France ruled by King Ferdinand IV. The Neapolitan army was defeated at Campo Tenese and rapidly disintegrated.

zh.s: 1806年那不勒斯入侵是第三次反法同盟战争期间的一场军事行动。安德烈·马塞纳元帅率领法军从意大利北部进军那不勒斯王国，入侵这个由费迪南多四世统治、与反法同盟结盟的国家。那不勒斯军队在坎波特内塞战败，随后迅速瓦解。

en.s: The 1818 United Kingdom general election was the 5th general election after the Acts of Union 1800, held on 17 June 1818 to 18 July 1818. It saw the Whigs gain a few seats, but the Tories under the Earl of Liverpool retained a majority of around 90 seats. The Whigs were divided over their response to growing social unrest and the introduction of the Corn Laws.

zh.s: 1818年英国大选是1800年《联合法案》之后的第5次大选，于1818年6月17日至7月18日举行。辉格党赢得少数席位，但利物浦伯爵领导的托利党仍保有约90席的多数优势。对于如何应对日益加剧的社会动荡以及《谷物法》的推出，辉格党内部意见分歧。

en.s: The Battle of Kosovo in 1831 took place between the Vizier of Bosnia Husein-kapetan Gradaščević and his loyalists together with local Albanians against the Ottoman Empire, whose troops were commanded by the Grand Vizier Reşid Mehmed Pasha.

zh.s: 1831年波斯尼亚科索沃战役的交战一方是波斯尼亚维齐尔侯赛因·卡佩坦·格拉达什切维奇及其支持者和当地阿尔巴尼亚人，另一方是奥斯曼帝国军队，由大维齐尔雷希德·穆罕默德帕夏指挥。

en.t: Coronation of Emperor Pedro II of Brazil
en.s: Dom Pedro II (Pedro de Alcântara João Carlos Leopoldo Salvador Bibiano Francisco Xavier de Paula Leocádio Miguel Gabriel Rafael Gonzaga; 2 December 1825 – 5 December 1891), known as "the Magnanimous" (Portuguese: O Magnânimo), was the second and final emperor of the Empire of Brazil. He reigned from 1831 until his deposition in the military coup of 1889, presiding over the longest and most stable reign in Brazilian history.

zh.t: 巴西皇帝佩德罗二世加冕
zh.s: 佩德罗二世（佩德罗·德·阿尔坎塔拉·若昂·卡洛斯·莱奥波尔多·萨尔瓦多·比比亚诺·弗朗西斯科·沙维尔·德·保拉·莱奥卡迪奥·米格尔·加布里埃尔·拉斐尔·贡萨加；1825年12月2日—1891年12月5日），绰号“宽宏者”（葡萄牙语：O Magnânimo），是巴西帝国第二位也是最后一位皇帝。他于1831年登基，1889年在军事政变中被废黜；在其统治期间，巴西经历了历史上最长且最稳定的统治时期。

en.s: The Battle of Tachekkirt was an 1854 battle between the French forces of Marshal Jacques Louis Randon and the allied Algerian forces of Lalla Fatma N'Soumer and Sherif Boubaghla. The Algerian forces feared that the French would launch a surprise attack. Shortly after the appearance of Lalla Fatma N'Soumer and her reinforcements, composed of Kabyle warriors, they assumed strategic positions and lookouts were placed.

zh.s: 塔切基尔特战役是1854年法国军队与阿尔及利亚联军之间的一场战斗。法国军队由雅克·路易·朗东元帅指挥，阿尔及利亚联军则由拉拉·法特玛·恩苏梅尔和谢里夫·布巴格拉率领。阿尔及利亚军队担心法军会发动突袭。拉拉·法特玛·恩苏梅尔及其由卡比尔战士组成的援军抵达后，阿尔及利亚军队随即占据战略位置并设置瞭望哨。

en.s: The siege of Fort Medina took place in 1857 at Médine, on the left bank of the Senegal River in present-day Mali. The Toucouleur forces of Omar Saidou Tall unsuccessfully besieged native and French colonial troops commanded by Paul Holle. After 97 days of siege, a relief force under French Governor Louis Faidherbe lifted the siege and forced the Toucouleur army to retreat.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1857年，图库洛尔军队在今马里、塞内加尔河左岸的梅迪纳围攻要塞。奥马尔·赛义杜·塔尔率领的图库洛尔军队未能攻下由保罗·霍尔指挥的当地部队和法国殖民军驻军。围城持续97天后，法国总督路易·费代尔布率援军解围，迫使图库洛尔军队撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Blackburn's Ford took place on July 18, 1861, in Prince William County and Fairfax County, Virginia, as part of the First Manassas Campaign of the American Civil War. A Union brigade was ordered to probe the Confederate defenses along Bull Run to locate the Confederate left. At Blackburn's Ford, the brigade attempted to cross but Confederate fire broke up the attack and Union commanders decided to cross the creek farther upstream.

zh.s: 布莱克本渡口战役于1861年7月18日在弗吉尼亚州威廉王子县和费尔法克斯县发生，是第一次马纳萨斯战役的一部分。联邦军一个旅奉命沿布尔溪试探邦联军防线，寻找其左翼。联邦军试图在布莱克本渡口过河，但遭邦联军火力击退，联邦指挥官随后决定改在上游渡河。

en.s: The Newburgh Raid was a successful raid by Confederate partisans on Newburgh, Indiana, on July 18, 1862, making it the first town in a northern state to be captured during the American Civil War. Confederate colonel Adam Rankin Johnson led the raid by using a force of only about 35 men he had recruited from nearby Henderson, Kentucky.

zh.s: 1862年7月18日，南方邦联游击队成功突袭印第安纳州纽堡，使其成为美国南北战争期间首个被攻占的北方州城镇。南方邦联上校亚当·兰金·约翰逊率领约35名从肯塔基州亨德森附近招募的人员发动突袭。

en.s: The Second Battle of Fort Wagner, also known as the Second Assault on Morris Island or the Battle of Fort Wagner, Morris Island, was fought on July 18, 1863, during the American Civil War. Union Army troops commanded by Brig. Gen. Quincy Gillmore launched an unsuccessful assault on the Confederate fortress of Fort Wagner, which protected Morris Island, south of Charleston Harbor.

zh.s: 瓦格纳堡第二次战役又称莫里斯岛第二次突击或瓦格纳堡战役，于1863年7月18日在美国南北战争期间爆发。昆西·吉尔莫准将率领联邦军向南部邦联的瓦格纳堡发起进攻，但未能攻下这座守卫莫里斯岛、位于查尔斯顿港以南的堡垒。

en.s: The Wytheville Raid or Toland's Raid (July 18, 1863) was an attack by an undersized Union brigade on a Confederate town during the American Civil War. Union Colonel John Toland led a brigade of over 800 men against a Confederate force of about 130 soldiers and 120 civilians. The location of Wytheville, the county seat of Wythe County in southwestern Virginia, had strategic importance because of a nearby lead mine and the railroad that served it.

zh.s: 怀斯维尔突袭，又称托兰突袭，于1863年7月18日发生在美国南北战争期间，是联邦军一支兵力不足的旅对南方邦联城镇发动的进攻。联邦军上校约翰·托兰率领800多名士兵，对抗约130名南方邦联士兵和120名平民。怀斯维尔是弗吉尼亚州西南部怀斯县的县治，附近的铅矿和铁路使其具有战略价值。

en.s: The second battle of Charleston Harbor, also known as the siege of Charleston Harbor, the siege of Fort Wagner, or the battle of Morris Island, took place during the American Civil War in the late summer of 1863 between a combined U.S. Army/Navy force and the Confederate defenses of Charleston, South Carolina.

zh.t: 查尔斯顿港第二次战役
zh.s: 查尔斯顿港第二次战役又称查尔斯顿港围城战、瓦格纳堡围城战或莫里斯岛战役，于1863年夏末在美国南北战争期间爆发。交战双方是美国陆海军联军与南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿的南方邦联守军。

en.s: The Battle of Fandane-Thiouthioune (or Thiouthiogne), also known as the Battle of Somb or the Battle of Somb-Tioutioune, occurred on 18 July 1867. It was a religious war between the Serer people and the Muslim Marabouts in 19th-century Senegal and the Gambia, but it also had a political and economic dimension to it: vendetta and empire-building.

zh.t: 凡达内—蒂乌蒂乌内战役
zh.s: 凡达内—蒂乌蒂乌内战役又称蒂乌蒂奥涅战役、松布战役或松布—蒂乌蒂乌内战役，于1867年7月18日爆发。这是塞内加尔和冈比亚地区谢雷尔人与穆斯林宗教领袖之间的一场宗教战争，也涉及政治和经济因素，包括复仇和扩张势力。

en.s: The Battle of Acayuazá was fought on July 18, 1868, on the outskirts of Reduto-Corá between the allied troops of the Triple Alliance and the Paraguayan army. Despite being outnumbered, the Paraguayan troops prevailed over the allies.

zh.s: 阿卡尤阿萨战役于1868年7月18日在雷杜托—科拉郊外爆发，交战双方是三国同盟联军和巴拉圭军队。尽管人数处于劣势，巴拉圭军队仍击败了联军。

en.t: The Ballot Act 1872 in the United Kingdom introduced the requirement that parliamentary and local government elections be held by secret ballot
en.s: The Ballot Act 1872 (35 & 36 Vict. c. 33) was an act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom that introduced the requirement for parliamentary and local government elections in the United Kingdom to be held by secret ballot. The act abolished the traditional hustings system of nomination and election in Britain.

zh.t: 1872年英国《投票法》确立议会和地方政府选举的无记名投票制度
zh.s: 英国议会通过的《1872年投票法》（35 & 36 Vict. c. 33）规定，英国议会和地方政府选举须采用无记名投票。该法废除了英国传统的公开提名和投票制度。

en.s: The Battle of Vučji Do (Serbian Cyrillic: Битка код Вучјег дола) was a major battle that took place on 18 July 1876 in Vučji Do, Sanjak of Herzegovina, fought between the combined forces of Montenegrin and Eastern Herzegovinian tribes (battalions) against the Ottoman Army under Grand Vizier Ahmed Muhtar Pasha. The Montenegrin-Herzegovinian forces heavily defeated the Ottomans, and managed to capture two of their commanders.

zh.s: 武奇耶多战役（塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Битка код Вучјег дола）于1876年7月18日在黑塞哥维那桑贾克的武奇耶多爆发，交战双方是黑山和东黑塞哥维那部族组成的联军，以及由大维齐尔艾哈迈德·穆赫塔尔帕夏率领的奥斯曼军队。黑山和黑塞哥维那联军大败奥斯曼军，并俘获其两名指挥官。

en.s: The Third Battle of Manzanillo was fought in the harbor of Manzanillo, Cuba on July 18, 1898. A large squadron of the United States Navy consisting of gunboats and auxiliaries attacked and cleared the harbor of a comparable force of Spanish vessels in the third largest naval battle of the Spanish–American War.

zh.s: 曼萨尼约第三次海战于1898年7月18日在古巴曼萨尼约港发生。美国海军一支由炮艇和辅助舰组成的大型舰队袭击并清除了港内规模相近的西班牙舰队。这是美西战争中规模第三大的海战。

zh.s: 科尔恩谷选区于1907年7月18日举行议会补选。该选区向英国下议院选出1名议员，采用简单多数制。

en.s: The siege of Vidin was an attempt by the Serbian Army to seize the Bulgarian city of Vidin during the Second Balkan War. The siege took place between 12 and 18 July 1913.

en.s: The Southern Dobruja Offensive was the opening action of the Romanian invasion of Bulgaria during the Second Balkan War of 1913. At the time of the invasion, the Bulgarian Army was engaged in heavy fighting against Serbia and Greece. Aside from Southern Dobruja itself, Varna was also briefly occupied by Romanian cavalry, until it became apparent that no Bulgarian resistance would be offered.

en.t: The U.S. Congress forms the Aviation Section, U.S. Signal Corps, giving official status to aircraft within the U.S. Army for the first time
en.s: The Aviation Section, Signal Corps, was the aerial warfare service of the United States from 1914 to 1918, and a direct statutory ancestor of the United States Air Force. It absorbed and replaced the Aeronautical Division, Signal Corps, and conducted the activities of Army aviation until its statutory responsibilities were suspended by President Woodrow Wilson in 1918.

zh.t: 美国国会成立陆军信号兵团航空科，首次赋予军用飞机正式地位
zh.s: 陆军信号兵团航空科是美国1914年至1918年的空战部门，也是美国空军直接的法定前身。它接替了陆军信号兵团航空部门，负责陆军航空事务；1918年，伍德罗·威尔逊总统暂停了该部门的法定职责。

en.s: The second battle of Przasnysz took place at the beginning of a major Bug-Narew Offensive of the Imperial German army on the German Eastern front. In the course of a stubborn battle, German troops under the command of Max von Gallwitz broke into the heavily fortified defenses of the outnumbered Russian army and took the city of Przasnysz.

zh.s: 普拉斯尼什第二次战役发生在德意志帝国军队东线大规模布格—纳雷夫攻势初期。经过一场激烈的战斗，马克斯·冯·加尔维茨指挥的德军突破了人数较少的俄军坚固防线，占领普拉斯尼什市。

en.s: The Second Battle of the Marne (French: Seconde Bataille de la Marne; 15 – 18 July 1918) was the last major German offensive on the Western Front during the First World War. The attack failed when an Allied counterattack, led by French forces and supported by several hundred Renault FT tanks, overwhelmed the Germans on their right flank, inflicting severe casualties.

zh.s: 马恩河第二次战役（法语：Seconde Bataille de la Marne）于1918年7月15日至18日爆发，是第一次世界大战期间德军在西线发动的最后一次大规模攻势。德军进攻失败，法国军队率领盟军反攻，并得到数百辆雷诺FT坦克支援，击溃德军右翼，造成其重大伤亡。

en.s: The German spring offensive, also known as Kaiserschlacht ("Emperor's Battle") or the Ludendorff offensive, was a series of German attacks along the Western Front during the First World War, beginning on 21 March 1918. Following the American entry into the war in April 1917, the Germans decided that their only remaining chance of victory was to defeat the Allies before the United States could ship soldiers across the Atlantic and fully deploy its resources.

zh.s: 德军春季攻势又称‘皇帝会战’或鲁登道夫攻势，是第一次世界大战期间德军自1918年3月21日起，在西线发动的一系列进攻。美国于1917年4月参战后，德国认为仅存的获胜机会，是赶在美国将大批士兵运过大西洋、全面投入其资源之前，击败协约国。

en.s: The 1921 Alberta general election was held on July 18, 1921, to elect members to the 5th Alberta Legislative Assembly. The United Farmers of Alberta is elected to replace the Liberal government. It was one of only five times that Alberta changed governments. A very-new United Farmers of Alberta political party defeated the Liberal Party, which had governed the province since its creation in 1905, led by Charles Stewart at the time of the election.

zh.s: 艾伯塔省于1921年7月18日举行大选，选出第五届省议会议员。当时成立不久的艾伯塔省联合农民党击败自由党，取代自由党政府。自1905年该省成立以来，自由党一直执政，时任领袖为查尔斯·斯图尔特。这是艾伯塔省历史上仅有的五次政府更替之一。

en.s: The 1922 Manitoba general election was held on July 18, 1922 to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. The United Farmers of Manitoba won a narrow majority in the legislature. As in the previous election of 1920, the city of Winnipeg elected ten members by the single transferable ballot. All other constituencies elected one member by first-past-the-post balloting.

zh.s: 加拿大曼尼托巴省于1922年7月18日举行大选，选出省议会议员。曼尼托巴省联合农民党在议会中以微弱优势赢得多数席位。与1920年上届选举一样，温尼伯市通过可转移单票制选出10名议员，其他选区则各选出1名议员，采用简单多数制。

en.s: Mein Kampf (German: [maɪn ˈkampf]; lit. 'My Struggle') is a 1925 autobiographical and political manifesto by Adolf Hitler, the leader of the Nazi Party. The book outlines many of Hitler's political beliefs, his political ideology, and his future plans for Germany and the world. Volume 1 of Mein Kampf was published in 1925 and Volume 2 in 1926. The combined volumes encompass roughly 750 pages.

zh.s: 《我的奋斗》（德语：Mein Kampf，意为“我的奋斗”）是纳粹党领袖阿道夫·希特勒于1925年出版的自传和政治宣言。书中阐述了希特勒的许多政治主张、政治意识形态，以及他对德国和世界的未来计划。《我的奋斗》第一卷于1925年出版，第二卷于1926年出版，两卷合计约750页。

en.s: The 1928 British Columbia general election was the seventeenth general election in the Province of British Columbia, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election was called on June 7, 1928, and held on July 18, 1928. The new legislature met for the first time on January 22, 1929.

zh.s: 1928年不列颠哥伦比亚省大选是加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省第17次大选，选出该省省议会议员。选举于1928年6月7日宣布，并于7月18日举行。新一届省议会于1929年1月22日首次开会。

en.s: The Beisfjord massacre (Norwegian: Beisfjord-massakren) was a massacre on 18 July 1942 in Beisfjord, Norway of 288 political prisoners who were killed at Lager I Beisfjord (German for "Beisfjord Camp No.1", Norwegian: Beisfjord fangeleir). The massacre had been ordered a few days earlier by the Reichskommissar for Norway Josef Terboven.

en.s: Operation Scylla (Italian: Operazione Scilla) was the transit of Scipione Africano, a Regia Marina (Italian Royal Navy) Capitani Romani-class cruiser, on the night of 17/18 July 1943, during the Second World War. The cruiser sailed from La Spezia in the Tyrrhenian Sea to Taranto in the Ionian Sea during the Allied invasion of Sicily. Scipione Africano fought a night engagement against four British motor torpedo boats (MTBs) during its passage of the Strait of Messina.

zh.t: 斯基皮奥内·阿非利加诺号通过墨西拿海峡（斯基拉行动）
zh.s: 斯基拉行动（意大利语：Operazione Scilla）指意大利皇家海军“斯基皮奥内·阿非利加诺”号巡洋舰于1943年7月17日至18日夜间的航行。第二次世界大战期间，盟军入侵西西里岛时，该舰从第勒尼安海的拉斯佩齐亚驶往爱奥尼亚海的塔兰托。航经墨西拿海峡时，“斯基皮奥内·阿非利加诺”号与4艘英国鱼雷快艇交战。

The battle was the result of an Allied plan to capture the city of Ancona in Italy in order to gain possession of a seaport closer to the fighting so that they could shorten their lines of communication.

en.t: World War II: Hideki Tōjō resigns as Prime Minister of Japan because of numerous setbacks in the war effort
en.s: Hideki Tojo (30 December 1884 – 23 December 1948) was a Japanese military officer and politician who served as Prime Minister of Japan from 1941 to 1944 during World War II. His leadership was marked by widespread state violence and mass killings perpetrated in the name of Japanese nationalism. Born into a military family of samurai descent in Kōjimachi, Tokyo, Tojo followed in his father's footsteps by pursuing a military career, graduating from the Imperial Japanese Army Academy in 1905.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：战争接连受挫后，东条英机辞去日本首相职务
zh.s: 东条英机（1884年12月30日—1948年12月23日）是日本军官和政治人物，1941年至1944年第二次世界大战期间担任日本首相。他任内以日本民族主义之名实施大规模国家暴力和杀戮。东条英机出生于东京麹町的武士后裔军人家庭，追随父亲从军，并于1905年毕业于日本陆军士官学校。

en.s: The Battle for Jerusalem took place during the 1947–1948 civil war phase of the 1947–1949 Palestine war. It saw Jewish and Arab militias in Mandatory Palestine, and later the militaries of Israel and Transjordan, fight for control over the city of Jerusalem. Under the 1947 United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine, Jerusalem was to be a corpus separatum (lit. 'separated body') administered by an international body.

The defenders, which were Eritrean Police commandos, had been trained by the Israeli military.

It was Olympiacos' thirteenth Greek Cup final and eighth consecutive in their 38 years of existence and Pierikos' first ever Greek Cup final in their 2-year history.

en.t: Intel is founded in Mountain View, California
en.s: Intel Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units (CPUs) and related products for business and consumer markets. Intel was the world's third-largest semiconductor chip manufacturer by revenue in 2024 and has been included in the Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by revenue since 2007.

zh.t: 英特尔在加利福尼亚州山景城成立
zh.s: 英特尔公司是一家总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的美国跨国科技公司。它设计、制造和销售中央处理器（CPU）等计算机组件及相关产品，面向企业和消费者市场。按2024年营收计算，英特尔是全球第三大半导体芯片制造商；自2007年以来一直入选按营收排名的美国大型企业《财富》500强榜单。

en.s: The modern Olympic Games (Olympics; French: Jeux olympiques) are a series of international multi-sport events. Considered among the biggest sporting events in the world, the Olympics are organised into distinct Summer and Winter Games, each featuring different sports. The Olympic Games, open to both amateur and professional athletes, involve thousands of athletes and more than 200 teams, each team representing a sovereign state or territory.

en.s: On 18 July 1979, a portion of the Iliwerung volcano on Lembata collapsed into the Savu Sea, triggering a deadly tsunami that swept along the island's coastal villages. The tsunami was triggered by a landslide rather than a volcanic eruption. Estimates of the dead start at 539 while another 700 were reported missing. Many of the dead were never recovered.

en.s: The Plan de Sánchez massacre took place in the Guatemalan village of Plan de Sánchez, Baja Verapaz department, on 18 July 1982. Over 250 people (mostly women and children, and almost exclusively ethnic Achi Maya) were abused and murdered by members of the armed forces and their paramilitary allies. The killings took place during one of the most violent phases of Guatemala's Civil War, which pitted various groups of left-wing insurgents against the government and the armed forces.

en.s: The 1982 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Semple Stadium on 18 July 1982 to determine the winners of the 1982 Munster Senior Hurling Championship. The final remains notable in the competition's history for the unprecedented margin of victory. Cork's defeat of Waterford by 5-31 to 3-6 established a record for the largest winning margin in the Munster Senior Hurling Championship final, a record that stood for many years.

en.s: The San Ysidro McDonald's massacre was a mass shooting that occurred in and around a McDonald's restaurant in the San Diego neighborhood of San Ysidro on July 18, 1984. The perpetrator, 41-year-old James Huberty, shot and killed 21 people and injured 19 others before being fatally shot by a SWAT team sniper. The shooting ranked as the deadliest mass shooting committed in the United States until the 1991 Luby's shooting. It is the second deadliest shooting rampage in which the perpetrator was killed by police as opposed to committing suicide, behind only the 2016 Orlando nightclub shooting.

zh.s: 圣伊西德罗麦当劳大屠杀是一起大规模枪击案，于1984年7月18日在美国加利福尼亚州圣迭戈圣伊西德罗社区的一家麦当劳餐厅内外发生。41岁的枪手詹姆斯·休伯蒂射杀21人、打伤19人，随后被特警队狙击手击毙。在1991年拉比百货商店枪击案发生之前，这曾是美国死亡人数最多的大规模枪击案。若仅统计被警方击毙、而非自杀身亡的枪手所制造的枪击事件，它是死亡人数第二多的一起，仅次于2016年奥兰多夜店枪击案。

en.s: Beach Blast 1993 was a major professional wrestling show that took place on July 18, 1993 at the Mississippi Coast Coliseum in Biloxi, Mississippi and was broadcast live on pay-per-view (PPV) in the United States. The show was produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW) and was the second year that WCW had used the name "Beach Blast" for one of their shows. en.s: The AMIA bombing was an attack on the Asociación Mutual Israelita Argentina (AMIA; Argentine Israelite Mutual Association) building. It occurred in Buenos Aires on 18 July 1994, killing 85 people and injuring hundreds. It was Argentina's deadliest bombing ever. Argentina is home to a Jewish community of 230,000, the largest in Latin America and sixth in the world outside Israel (see Demographics of Argentina).

zh.t: 阿根廷以色列互助协会爆炸案
zh.s: 1994年7月18日，阿根廷以色列互助协会（AMIA）大楼在布宜诺斯艾利斯遭到袭击，造成85人死亡、数百人受伤。这是阿根廷历史上死亡人数最多的爆炸案。阿根廷拥有23万犹太人，是拉丁美洲最大的犹太社群，也是以色列以外全球第六大犹太社群。

en.s: Ruleta de la Muerte (1998) was a professional wrestling Pay-Per-View event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on July 18, 1998 in Palacio de los Deportes, Mexico City, Mexico. en.s: On July 18, 1998, a Yugoslav Army (VJ) border patrol ambushed a column of Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) insurgents and foreign mujahideen just west of Deçan, on the frontier between Albania and Yugoslavia. The ambush resulted in the deaths of four KLA fighters and 18 mujahideen, most of whom were citizens of Saudi Arabia. Twelve militants were wounded, and a further six were arrested by the Yugoslav authorities and charged with illegal entry and gunrunning.

en.s: A Presidential election took place in Fiji on 18 July 2000, to replace Ratu Sir Kamisese Mara, who had resigned, possibly under pressure from the Military, during the Fiji coup of 2000. The Great Council of Chiefs, an assembly of mostly hereditary chiefs which is constitutionally empowered to elect the President, chose the Tui Vuda (Paramount Chief of Vuda), Ratu Josefa Iloilovatu Uluivuda (commonly known simply as Ratu Josefa Iloilo), who had been Vice-President under Mara, to succeed him. Iloilo had already exercised Presidential duties since 13 July, when the Military had asked him to take over the office.

zh.s: 斐济于2000年7月18日举行总统选举，接替已辞职的拉图·卡米塞塞·马拉爵士。马拉辞职可能是军方施压所致，时间正值2000年斐济政变期间。宪法授权大酋长委员会选举总统；该委员会主要由世袭酋长组成。委员会选出武达最高酋长拉图·约瑟法·伊洛伊洛接替马拉。他此前担任副总统。军方于7月13日要求他接任总统职务，此后他已开始行使总统职责。

en.s: The Perejil Island crisis (Spanish: Incidente de la Isla de Perejil; Arabic: أزمة جزيرة تورة) was a bloodless armed conflict between Spain and Morocco that took place on 11–18 July 2002. The incident took place over the small, uninhabited Perejil Island, when a squad of the Royal Moroccan Navy occupied it. After an exchange of declarations between both countries, the Spanish troops eventually evicted the Moroccan infantry who had relieved their Navy comrades.

en.s: Destiny was the first Destiny professional wrestling event produced by Pro Wrestling Noah. The event took place on July 18, 2005 at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan, and marked Noah's second event to take place in the arena, after 2004's Departure. The main event was marketed as the last match between longtime rivals Toshiaki Kawada and Mitsuharu Misawa, who, once both signed to All Japan Pro Wrestling (AJPW), had since gone separate ways, with Kawada remaining in All Japan and Misawa leaving to form Noah.

zh.s: Destiny是职业摔角联盟诺亚职业摔角举办的首场Destiny赛事，于2005年7月18日在日本东京的东京巨蛋举行。这是诺亚第二次在该场馆举办赛事，此前一次是2004年的Departure。主赛被宣传为长期宿敌川田利明与三泽光晴之间的最后一场比赛。两人此前都曾签约全日本职业摔角，后来分道扬镳：川田留在全日本，三泽则离开并创立诺亚。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Mauritania on 18 July 2009. Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz, who led the 2008 coup d'état, won a narrow first-round majority in the election, according to official results. A second round, if necessary, would have been held on 1 August 2009. Following the coup which deposed President Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi on 6 August 2008, the new junta (the High Council of State) promised that a presidential election would be held "as soon as possible". The election was subsequently scheduled for 6 June 2009.

zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于2009年7月18日举行总统选举。领导2008年政变的穆罕默德·乌尔德·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹根据官方结果在首轮选举中以微弱优势获胜。如有需要，第二轮原定于2009年8月1日举行。2008年8月6日，政变推翻总统西迪·乌尔德·谢赫·阿卜杜拉希后，新军政府（国家高级委员会）承诺将“尽快”举行总统选举。选举随后安排在2009年6月6日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Burgas bus bombing was a terrorist attack carried out by a suicide bomber on a passenger bus transporting Israeli tourists at the Burgas Airport in Burgas, Bulgaria on 18 July 2012. The bus was carrying forty-two Israelis, mainly youths, from the airport to their hotels, after arriving on a flight from Tel Aviv. The explosion killed the Bulgarian bus driver and five Israelis and injured thirty-two Israelis, resulting in international condemnation of the bombing. In February 2013, Tsvetan Tsvetanov, the Bulgarian interior minister, said there was “well-grounded” evidence that Hezbollah was behind the attack.

zh.s: 2012年7月18日，一名自杀式袭击者在保加利亚布尔加斯机场袭击了一辆载有以色列游客的客车。车上有42名以色列人，大多是年轻人，他们刚乘飞机从特拉维夫抵达，正从机场前往酒店。爆炸造成保加利亚司机和5名以色列人死亡，另有32名以色列人受伤，引发国际社会谴责。2013年2月，保加利亚内政部长茨维坦·茨维坦诺夫表示，有“充分依据的证据”表明真主党与袭击有关。

en.s: The 18 July 2012 Damascus bombing, widely known as the "Crisis Cell" bombing, of the National Security headquarters in Rawda Square, Damascus, killed and injured a number of top military and security officials of the Syrian government. Among the dead were the Syrian defense minister and deputy defense minister. The bombing occurred during the Syrian civil war, and is considered to be one of the most notorious events to affect the conflict.

zh.s: 2012年7月18日，大马士革拉乌达广场国家安全总部发生爆炸，造成叙利亚政府多名高级军事和安全官员死伤。遇难者包括叙利亚国防部长和副国防部长。爆炸发生在叙利亚内战期间，是这场冲突中最受关注的事件之一。这起爆炸案也常被称为“危机小组爆炸案”。

en.s: The 2013 Destination X (also known as Impact Wrestling: Destination X) was professional wrestling produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on July 18 at the Broadbent Arena in Louisville, Kentucky. It was the ninth event under the Destination X chronology. Unlike the previous events, this event was not held on pay-per-view (PPV) and instead aired as a special live episode of Impact Wrestling on Spike TV.

en.s: Operation Alpha 29 (Indonesian: Operasi Alfa 29) was a military operation launched by Team Alfa 29 from the 515th Raider Infantry Battalion Kostrad of the Indonesian Army on 18 July 2016 in Tambarana, Poso Regency, Central Sulawesi. en.s: General elections were held in Bermuda on 18 July 2017 to elect all 36 members to the House of Assembly. The result was a victory for the opposition Progressive Labour Party, which won 24 of the 36 seats. Incumbent Premier Michael Dunkley subsequently resigned as leader of the One Bermuda Alliance. Bob Richards, a senior minister and deputy premier in Dunkley's government unexpectedly lost his Devonshire East seat.

zh.s: 百慕大于2017年7月18日举行大选，选出众议院全部36名议员。反对党进步劳工党获胜，赢得36席中的24席。时任首席部长迈克尔·邓克利随后辞去百慕大联盟党党魁职务。邓克利政府的资深部长兼副首席部长鲍勃·理查兹意外地未能赢得德文郡东选区席位。

en.s: The 2020 Slammiversary was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on July 18, 2020, at the Skyway Studios in Nashville, Tennessee. It was the sixteenth event under the Slammiversary chronology. Seven matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Eddie Edwards defeated Ace Austin, Trey, Eric Young, and Rich Swann (the last two being unannounced participants) in a five-way elimination match to win the vacant Impact World Championship.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 18 July 2021. en.s: The Chilean presidential primaries of 2021 were held in Chile on Sunday 18 July 2021. According to the law, primaries are voluntary, but its results are binding. Two political coalitions decided to participate: Former minister Sebastián Sichel won the Chile Vamos primary with 49% of the vote, while deputy Gabriel Boric became the Apruebo Dignidad nominee with 60%. The Constituent Unity coalition decided not to participate.

zh.s: 智利于2021年7月18日（星期日）举行总统初选。根据法律，初选为自愿参加，但结果具有约束力。两个政治联盟决定参选：前部长塞巴斯蒂安·西切尔以49%的得票率赢得智利前进联盟初选；议员加夫列尔·博里奇以60%的得票率成为赞成尊严联盟的候选人。制宪团结联盟决定不参加。

en.s: The 2021 More Europe leadership election was a congressional primary election which took place on 16, 17 and 18 July 2021 at Rome to elect the new party leadership. The candidates to the Secretary were the outgoing Secretary and former MEP Benedetto Della Vedova and the former president of the think-tank FutureDem, Giulio del Balzo. en.s: The 2021 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match that was played on 18 July at Páirc Uí Chaoimh in Cork City. Bharatiya Janata Party candidate Droupadi Murmu won the election by a margin of 296,626 votes against Yashwant Sinha, the United Opposition candidate.

en.s: The 2022 CONCACAF W Championship Final was an association football match between Canada and the United States that took place on 18 July 2022. The match determined the winner of the 2022 CONCACAF W Championship at Estadio BBVA in Guadalupe, Mexico. It was the 11th final of the CONCACAF W Championship, a quadrennial tournament that consists of the women's national teams from CONCACAF to determine the best women's football country in North America, Central America, and the Caribbean.
